Chapter 6466: Destruction

Chapter 6466: Destruction

Rising and Earthsplitter had an ugly expression. Alch-deer was nothing in the real world but here was a different story.

“You’re too arrogant, Fellow Daoist.” Earthsplitter was furious, akin to being scorned by a junior.

“Please make your move then, Primal Ancestor.” Alch-deer challenged them with a wave and said: “The two of you together, I will display my meager skills today.”

This fake humbleness only served to infuriate the two further. The audience, especially the natives, had no problem with this because Alch-deer was the lord of the village.

Only Goldblade’s group smiled wryly. The world changed so fast and they didn’t know whether to laugh or cry.

“Fine, show us your golden power!” Earthsplitter raised her halberd at the opponent. She believed due to the golden boost, she could kill an eternal ancestor with this weapon.

As for Rising, he gained an additional level in his cultivation, going from the earth to the heaven level.

“Amitabha.” Rising summoned a wooden fish.

“Come, a spar it is.” Alch-deer looked dominant.

“Acting all cool again.” Black Wind grumbled.

“Die!” Earthsplitter released all her golden power, dazzling the spectators’ eyes.

It turned into a terrible storm sucking everything in. Mountains were crushed to pieces.

“Phoenix Extinguishment!” She roared while channeling everything into the golden halberd.

Phoenixes appeared in the air, ready to cut all affinities. They combined into the spear for a direct throw.

“Rumble!” Space collapsed amidst its trajectory.

“This is the end!” Everyone was scared out of their mind.

Meanwhile, Rising chanted while tapping the wooden fish.

“Buddist Lord!” He infused the power of Buddhism with the golden power, summoning a holy being too large for Gold Village to accommodate. Stars looked like specks of dust in comparison. People could only see its ankles due to its size.

“Destruction!” He commanded it to use a palm strike.

“Rumble!” The sky turned dark during its descent.

“Oh, mommy!” Many screamed in horror, unable to run due to the pressure coming from the halberd and the palm. However, the laws of sound have been disrupted and nothing came out of their mouth.

This would flatten all of Gold Village if not outright destroy it.

“Not bad, but watch me!” Alch-deer raised his hands while laughing.

“Golden Wish.” He didn’t use any technique and dao from Desolate Frontier. Each of his movements and breaths contained immense golden power.
